focus: Built modular multi-environment IaC using AWS CDK v2 and Terraform (-50% errors), implemented secretless OIDC CI/CD, cut DB spend by 30%, and integrated Bedrock & CloudWatch (-45% MTTR).
highlights: Built modular, multi-environment cloud infrastructure using AWS CDK v2 and Terraform, cutting provisioning errors by 50%.
Implemented secretless CI/CD in GitHub Actions via AWS IAM OIDC federation, eliminating static AWS access keys.
Cut compute costs and eliminated cold starts on high-traffic paths via direct API Gateway to DynamoDB/S3 VTL mapping templates.
Deployed on-demand data storage with DynamoDB (PITR, TTL, GSIs) and Aurora Serverless v2, reducing monthly AWS database spend by 30%.
Integrated Amazon Bedrock for automated API evaluations and centralized monitoring via CloudWatch alarms/dashboards, reducing MTTR by 45%.
